Paços de Ferreira season | website = {{URL|https://www.fcpf.pt/}} | pattern_la1 = _pacosferreira2223h | pattern_b1 = _pacosferreira2223h | pattern_ra1 = _pacosferreira2223h | pattern_sh1 = _pacosferreira2223h | pattern_so1 = _pacosferreira2223h | leftarm1 = FFDD00 | body1 = FFDD00 | rightarm1 = FFDD00 | shorts1 = 114422 | socks1 = FFDD00 | pattern_la2 = _pacosferreira2223a | pattern_b2 = _pacosferreira2223a | pattern_ra2 = _pacosferreira2223a | pattern_sh2 = | pattern_so2 = | leftarm2 = FFFFFF | body2 = FFFFFF | rightarm2 = FFFFFF | shorts2 = 000000 | socks2 = 000000 | pattern_la3 = _jomatoletum4wb | pattern_b3 = _jomatoletum4wb | pattern_ra3 = _jomatoletum4wb | pattern_sh3 = _whitesides | pattern_so3 = _whitetop | leftarm3 = 000000 | body3 = 000000 | rightarm3 = 000000 | shorts3 = 000000 | socks3 = 000000 }} '''Futebol Clube Paços de Ferreira''' ({{IPA|pt|ˈpasuʒ ðɨ fɨˈʁɐjɾɐ}}) is a Portuguese professional [[Association football|football]] club based in [[Paços de Ferreira]], [[Porto District]]. Founded in 1950, the club competes in [[ Liga 3 (Portugal)|Liga 3]], holding home games at the 9,076 seat [[Estádio Capital do Móvel]]{{Cite web |title=Estádio |url=https://www.fcpf.pt/estadio/ |access-date=2024-09-02 |website=FC Paços de Ferreira |language=pt-PT}} The club's colours are yellow and green. The club is owned 100% by its members ("sócios"). They have won four Segunda Liga titles (now Liga Portugal 2), and in 2007 they qualified for the [[UEFA Europa League|UEFA Cup]] for the first time. In the [[2012–13 Primeira Liga]], the team finished third and qualified for the [[2013–14 UEFA Champions League]] play-offs for the first time in their history. They were also runners-up of the [[2008–09 Taça de Portugal]], the [[2009 Supertaça Cândido de Oliveira]] and the [[2010–11 Taça da Liga]]."}}
